scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check the status of my loan application. Can you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what is the interest rate and total costs for the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and purchased by Freddie Mac. The interest rate for your loan is 7.375%. However, the total loan costs are not available in the record.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for that information. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, what is my debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your loan does not have negative amortization features and is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. However, the debt-to-income ratio is not available in the record.

dialogue.user: Got it. One last question: What type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I am ending the conversation now. <Neutral> The agent provided the information that was available in the record, but I was disappointed that I couldn't get the total loan costs or my debt-to-income ratio.
